headline: Approve with conditions: roll out in stages

sections.title: Recommendation
sections.body: At plan, this project is worth {{npv}} in today's dollars (net present value) and pays back in {{payback_years}} years. That cushion is thin. If yearly cash flows come in a tenth below plan, the value falls to {{npv_flows_minus_10}}. We recommend approving, but only with the safeguards below.

conditions: Roll out one zone first, and expand only after it has run reliably for a full quarter.
Before phase two, compare actual labor savings with the plan. If they're running a tenth or more short, pause. At that level the project stops paying off ({{npv_flows_minus_10}}).
disagreements_addressed: The CFO Stress-Tester leaned toward deferring, because the project loses money if savings fall short. Operations Risk was comfortable going ahead with a checkpoint. We side with going ahead, because the conditions above limit how much is spent before a shortfall would show up.
